The local analogs also point in the same direction: the molecule repeatedly sits closer to the non-substrate neighborhood than to the substrate-like one, especially because the recurring thiazole-containing query still does not develop the stronger cationic character typical of CYP2D6 substrates. Taken together, the balance favors a non-substrate assignment.
